## 13 - EGX Report API

Read-only webhook endpoints over the scanner's Postgres views (section 25/26/36). Each route checks `Authorization: Bearer $REPORT_WEBHOOK_SECRET` — if the secret env var is empty, the route stays open (documented public-read choice, section 38). All queries are parameterized or built from a strict server-side whitelist — no raw user input is ever concatenated into SQL.

Requires 11-egx-overall-ranking to have run at least once (reads from v_full_market / v_scanner_top / v_latest_scanner_run).

**After import:** each Webhook node needs the workflow ACTIVATED (top-right toggle) for its production URL to respond — see docs/IMPORT-N8N.md.

parameters.query:
WITH target_date AS (
  SELECT MAX(rf.trading_date) AS d
  FROM range_forecast rf JOIN stocks s ON s.id = rf.stock_id
  WHERE s.exchange = $1 AND ($2::date IS NULL OR rf.trading_date <= $2::date)
)
SELECT s.symbol, s.name, rf.trading_date::text AS trading_date, rf.close::float8 AS close,
       rf.next_high_estimate::float8 AS next_high_estimate,
       rf.next_low_estimate::float8 AS next_low_estimate,
       rf.accuracy_pct::float8 AS accuracy_pct, rf.sample_size,
       nxt.actual_date::text AS actual_date,
       nxt.actual_high::float8 AS actual_high,
       nxt.actual_low::float8 AS actual_low,
       CASE WHEN nxt.actual_high IS NULL THEN NULL
            WHEN nxt.actual_high <= rf.next_high_estimate AND nxt.actual_low >= rf.next_low_estimate THEN TRUE
            ELSE FALSE END AS in_range
FROM range_forecast rf
JOIN stocks s ON s.id = rf.stock_id
LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
  SELECT dp.trading_date AS actual_date, dp.high AS actual_high, dp.low AS actual_low
  FROM daily_prices dp
  WHERE dp.stock_id = rf.stock_id AND dp.trading_date > rf.trading_date
  ORDER BY dp.trading_date ASC LIMIT 1
) nxt ON TRUE
WHERE s.exchange = $1 AND rf.trading_date = (SELECT d FROM target_date)
ORDER BY s.symbol;

parameters.query:
SELECT
  COALESCE(run.run_type, 'ALL') AS scope,
  COALESCE(r.setup_type, 'ALL') AS setup_type,
  COUNT(*)::int AS picks,
  COUNT(twe.outcome)::int AS evaluated,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE twe.outcome = 'TARGET1_HIT')::int AS target1_hit,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE twe.outcome = 'STOP_HIT')::int AS stop_hit,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE twe.outcome = 'EXPIRED_NO_HIT')::int AS expired,
  (COUNT(*) - COUNT(twe.outcome))::int AS pending,
  CASE WHEN COUNT(twe.outcome) > 0 THEN ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE twe.outcome = 'TARGET1_HIT') / COUNT(twe.outcome), 1)::float8 END AS success_rate_pct,
  CASE WHEN COUNT(twe.outcome) > 0 THEN ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE twe.outcome = 'STOP_HIT') / COUNT(twe.outcome), 1)::float8 END AS failure_rate_pct,
  CASE WHEN COUNT(twe.outcome) > 0 THEN ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE twe.outcome = 'EXPIRED_NO_HIT') / COUNT(twe.outcome), 1)::float8 END AS expired_rate_pct,
  ROUND(AVG(twe.resolved_day_number) FILTER (WHERE twe.outcome = 'TARGET1_HIT'), 1)::float8 AS avg_days_to_target,
  ROUND(AVG((r.target1 - r.entry_price) / r.entry_price * 100)::numeric, 2)::float8 AS avg_target_gain_pct
FROM scanner_results r
JOIN scanner_runs run ON run.id = r.scanner_run_id
JOIN markets m ON m.code = run.market
LEFT JOIN target_window_evaluation twe ON twe.scanner_result_id = r.id
WHERE run.market = $1
  AND r.eligible = TRUE
  AND r.target1 IS NOT NULL
  AND r.overall_rank <= 10
  -- Only picks whose Target 1 was worth reaching count toward the record:
  -- a resistance 0.3% away is 'hit' ~80% of the time by daily noise and
  -- let the 2026-08-24 calibration game this very statistic.
  AND r.entry_price > 0
  AND (r.target1 - r.entry_price) / r.entry_price * 100 >= m.min_target_gain_pct
GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ((run.run_type, r.setup_type), (run.run_type), ())
ORDER BY (run.run_type IS NULL)::int, run.run_type DESC, (r.setup_type IS NOT NULL)::int, r.setup_type;
